# appsignal_log_filter (Resource)

A log filter in an AppSignal app: matching lines are dropped at ingestion and never stored. Log actions run in order and new ones are added last; see appsignal_log_action_order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appsignal_log_filter" "health_checks" {
  app_id = appsignal_app.web.id
  name   = "Health checks"
  query  = "message:\"GET /healthz\""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `query` (String) Log query selecting the lines. AppSignal does not validate it, so check it in the log viewer first.

### Optional

- `source_ids` (Set of String) Log sources the action applies to. Empty means every source of the app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import appsignal_log_filter.health_checks <app_id>/<log_action_id>
```
